atoms.b: During the summer, when it was easier to ((++sail swim)) from Norway, Vikings carried out raids on Britain.
Vikings raided Britain for items that they could ((++steal paint)) and trade. Raids were also a way for Vikings to show their bravery.
Although some smaller raids had already happened, the first planned ((++raid party)) took place in Lindisfarne in AD 793.

feedback.end: In AD 793, a small group of Vikings attacked a monastery on the island of Lindisfarne in Northumbria. As the island was on the coast, it was an easy target for the Vikings travelling from Norway.

instruction.text: Build the picture of what the monks at Lindisfarne would have seen as the Vikings arrived.

feedback.end: The monks at Lindisfarne went down to the shore to greet the small group of boats. They did not expect the Vikings to start attacking them!

instruction.text: What do you think Lindisfarne monastery looked like after the raid?

feedback.end: During the raid, the Vikings attacked the monks, stole their treasure and burned down their buildings!
